name: Tila de Marcuse
source:
Tila de Marcuse is now the fully brainwashed sex slave of Dario Dalisso.

Note that, while she is mentioned briefly in the game, she does not show up in the game. Her character sprite only appears in the credits of the game.

The credits of the game heavily imply that Tila de Marcuse killed her father, the King of Marcuse, on Dario Dalisso's orders. Tila will likely inherit her dead father's throne now that he has died.

It's also noted that the public now knows that Tila "is having an affair". This is likely in reference to her sexual slavery to Dario.
